concept: The ticket stub is the event: its perforation becomes the agenda rule, its tear becomes the countdown, and the stamp is the CTA.

beatMap.lands: The stub slides up on the downbeat; the brand, headline, and ADMIT ONE land; the perforation draws on beat 3.
The date lands on beats 3-4.5; the tear line runs along the perforation one third per beat on beats 5-7.
The stub tears and drops; agenda rows cut in on beats 8, 9, and 10; the reader marker starts on beat 11.
The reader marker steps down the rows on each beat; the bar strip keeps filling.
The rows collapse; 3, 2, 1 land on beats 16-18 under the riser; on beat 19 an accent slab grows into the stamp.
Strongest impact on beat 20: the CTA stamps down; the arrow nudges; the stamp lifts on beat 23 and the strip drains to the empty frame 0.

handoffs.element: The perforation becomes the tear, and the stub's lower half drops away to reveal the agenda.
The agenda rows collapse into the first digit.
The last digit grows into the accent slab that becomes the stamp.

sound.concept: Each countdown digit is a kick under a rising sweep, and the CTA stamp is the final impact.

cueMap.kick: The bar strip and the reader marker move on every beat.
cueMap.date: The date's words land on plucks.
cueMap.point1: Each agenda row cuts in on its pluck.
cueMap.cta: The CTA words land on lead notes.

findings.issue: Agenda names at max length overflowed their rows.
findings.fix: The fit box uses a fixed flex basis with min-width 0, so the fit text measures the real width.

findings.issue: A word reveal placed before 0 shifted the whole GSAP timeline by 0.12 s and broke the loop.
findings.fix: Reveals are clamped to 0, and the runtime fails on any tween before 0 or after the score.

findings.issue: The first frame showed the stub edge and the last frame showed the stamp mid-exit.
findings.fix: The stub starts fully off-frame, and the stamp and strip finish before the loop point.

findings.issue: Beats 5-7, 11, and 19 had no visible motion.
findings.fix: Added the tear line, an earlier reader marker, and the slab that grows into the stamp.

approval.waiver: Operator approved shipping to test the mix in production.
